    A band from one line of the cover, without excluding contours #

    Let L be a line of the cover with a good pair of sinks, and call a path of Q_P along the band if it is the image of a directed path of the band cycle. A path along the band is a directed segment of L. If another path has the same value, the partner of its lift in the convex line L (exists_partner) is a path of L with the same ends, so it is the same path (CLine.path_unique). Hence the paths that are not along the band form a set RelPaths (relPaths_notAlong), and the kernel of kQ_P → k(P) lies in the span of their words. This gives a monomial-type band (lineBandRel) whose cycle has t' - t points, with no condition on contours of P (BO23, proof of Theorem 7).
